test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P alone can complete 50% of a piece of work in 6 days and Q can complete 50% of the same work in 9 days. With the help of R, they finish the work in 6 days. In how many days can R alone complete 25% of the work?
solution:
**Given:**

P alone can complete 50% of a piece of work in 6 days

Q can complete 50% of the same work in 9 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency of the workers × time taken by them

**Calculation:**

P alone can complete 50% of a piece of work in 6 days

So, P alone can complete 100% of a piece of work in 6 × 2 = 12 days

Q can complete 50% of the same work in 9 days

So, Q can complete 100% of the same work in 9 × 2 = 18 days

Now,

LCM of 12, 18 = 36 i.e total work

So, efficiency of P = 36/12 = 3 units/day

Efficiency of Q = 36/18 = 2 units/day

Now,

With the help of R they can complete the work in 6 days

So, effective efficiency of P, Q, and R = 36/6 = 6 units/day

Efficiency of R = 6 - 5 = 1 unit/day

So, R alone complete 25% of the work = (36 × 25%)/1

⇒ 9 days

**∴ R can alone complete 25% of the work in 9 days.**
